description: Facts turn roots: treat an observation with isRootObservation true as a turn boundary in the behavioral-training facts stage.

userStories.title: Treat a root observation as a turn boundary
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want each Claude Code turn root to end a guard follow-up so that the follow-up stays in one turn.
acceptanceCriteria: A failing test in `.agro/scripts/__tests__/behavioral-training-facts.test.ts` is committed before the change. The test gives a guard block, then a non-user event with `isRootObservation: true` and a non-null parent in another trace, then a tool call. The test expects the tool call to stay out of the follow-up of the block.
`isBoundary` in `facts.mjs` returns true for an event with `isRootObservation === true`.
A test proves that an event with `isRootObservation: false` and a non-null parent is still not a boundary.
`pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm run build` exit 0 in the task worktree.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a command transcript so that I can see the boundary rule on a fixture.
acceptanceCriteria: `evidence/manual-review.md` shows the facts test run and the `guardBlocks` follow-up of the new fixture before and after the change. The file holds no transcript content and no secret.
